name: KILT
description: Knowledge-intensive language tasks unified over a Wikipedia snapshot. Distinct from the already recorded FEVER, Natural Questions, TriviaQA, and HotpotQA source sets. No data vendored.
citation: Petroni et al. (2021). KILT: a Benchmark for Knowledge Intensive Language Tasks. NAACL 2021.

license.identifier: MIT (code); Wikipedia terms apply to data (no single SPDX identifier covers both)
